title: Bio-enhanced phytotherapeutic formulation comprising Boswellia serrata and Zingiber officinale
text:
FIELD: The invention provides stabilized botanical formulations for joint health.

PRIOR ART: Boswellia extracts have recognized anti-inflammatory properties through 5-LOX inhibition, but oral bioavailability of pentacyclic triterpenes remains low. The present invention demonstrates that complexation with standardized Zingiber terpenes significantly increases plasma AUC of AKBA by 240% compared to unformulated resin.
